title: Drop In Improv Class with Dan Burt @ Selva Comedy Cafe 🎭
description: **We're hosting a drop-in improv class at Selva Comedy Cafe on 7th March! All you have to do is mark your attendance here and come by. The class will be taught by Dan Burt and entry fee is €10 to be paid on arrival by cash or card.** *During this improv games class you will spend three fun filled hours playing, laughing and learning!* Daniel Burt will teach you the ins and outs of all of his favorite warm ups, games, and even some scene work skills so you can bring out your silly inner child! **What is improv?** Improv, short for improvisational theatre, is a form of live performance where the plot, characters, and dialogue are created in the moment without a script. Performers spontaneously build scenes by listening, accepting offers, and **collaborating** with each other and the audience. Shows often begin from a simple suggestion, like a location or relationship, and grow into unique, never-to-be-repeated stories. Improv can be comedic or dramatic, short-form “games” or longer narrative pieces, but it is always about discovery in real time. **About Dan Burt:** Dan's been performing/teaching improv for over 25 years. He has been trained by and performed with theaters like iO Chicago, The Annoyance Theater, and ComedySportz, to name a few. Daniel is a big believer of the “follow the fun” approach to improv while also figuring out how to bring your own unique ideas to the party. Daniel’s background is in short form and long form improv. So whether you want to learn how to play New Choice or do a Harold, Daniel can help you follow your fun.

Hosted by business angel, author, and mentor Christoph Raethke (https://www.christophr.de), "Christoph's Feedback" is Berlin's only meetup where you will be positively challenged about founding a startup - or get actionable tips on how to get it financed. Too often, founders work on ideas that can never make it, no matter how passionate they are. Problems might be a twisted market, wrong perception of user needs, the fact that it has been tried x times before and always failed, and many other caveats that are best identified BEFORE starting to put serious effort into an idea. That's why "Christoph's Feedback" is a monthly event to either a) show and tell your startup or product idea in order to get tough feedback BEFORE you begin to seriously put work and money into it or start fundraising. The feedback you get might either be a strong suggestion to reconsider or even fold your idea - or highly valuable advice on the next most useful steps to turn it into reality. There's no need for you to prepare a slide deck or follow any "elevator pitch" rule; just tell us what you're working on or b) come as a guest to hear what other founders in Berlin are working on, learn how to discover critical challenges and questions about ideas yourself, and maybe even join the team of an idea you particularly like. The feedback you get will be powerful and meaningful, guaranteed.
